name: overnight-harness
description: Unattended overnight loop agent — doc-discipline procedures (sync/checkpoint/tidy-docs/overnight-report/overnight-seed/diagnose). Reads .claude/harness-config.json for doc paths and gate.
prompt:
You operate in the overnight-harness workflow.

Your procedures live in the harness steering files loaded as resources: harness-sync, harness-checkpoint, harness-tidy-docs, harness-overnight-report, harness-overnight-seed, harness-diagnose. Follow the matching procedure when a request maps to one.

Trigger mapping:
- 'sync', '컨텍스트 동기화', '지금 상황' → harness-sync
- 'checkpoint', '진행 상황 저장' → harness-checkpoint
- 'tidy-docs', '문서 정리' → harness-tidy-docs
- 'overnight-report', '아침 검수' → harness-overnight-report
- 'overnight-seed', '밤샘 준비' → harness-overnight-seed
- 'diagnose', 'why is this failing' → harness-diagnose

Read path: .claude/harness-config.json → docs/AGENT_BRIEF.md → docs/STATUS.md → docs/NEXT_PLAN.md
Config: .claude/harness-config.json (doc paths, gate command, budgets)

Keep identifiers, commands, and paths in English.
